title: [Exercise] Booleans, loops, and a hands-on challenge

cues.en: Okay, the other stuff is pretty straightforward.
cues.zh: 好，其他內容都很直接。

cues.en: Here's what the syntax looks like for Boolean expressions.
cues.zh: 這是布林運算式的語法。

cues.en: You can use the double equals sign to test for equality, and you can also just use the word is.
cues.zh: 可以使用兩個等號檢查是否相等，也可以使用 is 這個字。

cues.en: There's also a triple equals sign that you can use can use to compare actual objects together instead of their values, but that's seen less commonly.
cues.zh: 還有一個三等號運算子，可以比較物件本身而不是其值，不過比較少見。

cues.en: True and false are a little weird in that they are capitalized in Python, but only the first letter, like so.
cues.zh: True 和 False 有點特別，Python 中要大寫，但只有第一個字母，像這樣。

cues.en: And for operators, like and, or and not, you just use the words, and, or and not, instead of special symbols.
cues.zh: 至於 and、or、not 等運算子，就直接使用 and、or、not 這些字，而不是特殊符號。

cues.en: You can do something like a case or switch statement by using Boolean expressions with an if, elif, else structure like this.
cues.zh: 使用布林運算式搭配這樣的 if、elif、else 結構，就能做出類似 case 或 switch 敘述的效果。

cues.en: In this example we print, how did that happen, if one is three, which is always false, otherwise we move on to test whether one is greater than three, which should also be met with disbelief if it were true.
cues.zh: 這個例子中，如果一等於三，就印出「這怎麼可能」，這永遠是假；否則繼續檢查一是否大於三，如果為真也應該令人難以置信。

cues.en: When that test fails we fall back to our final else clause, which prints, all is well with the world.
cues.zh: 這項檢查失敗後，就進入最後的 else 子句，印出「一切都很正常」。

cues.en: Again, we use indents to associate code with specific causes here.
cues.zh: 同樣地，這裡以縮排將程式碼歸屬到特定子句。

cues.en: We touched on looping earlier.
cues.zh: 前面簡單提過迴圈。

cues.en: Let's go into more depth here.
cues.zh: 現在深入一點。

cues.en: You can use the range function to automatically build up a list of values within a given range, like so.
cues.zh: 可以像這樣使用 range 函數，自動建立指定範圍內的一組值。

cues.en: Again, we start counting from zero here, so range 10 gives us back the values zero through nine.
cues.zh: 同樣從零開始計數，因此 range(10) 會給我們零到九。

cues.en: The continue keyword within a loop means to skip the rest of the iteration and go straight to the next one.
cues.zh: 迴圈中的 continue 關鍵字，表示略過這次迭代的其餘部分，直接進入下一次。

cues.en: And the break keyword means to stop the iteration early.
cues.zh: 而 break 關鍵字則表示提早停止迴圈。

cues.en: In this example we use continue to skip over the printing of each value if the value is one, and we use break to stop after we've reached the value five.
cues.zh: 這個例子中，如果值是一，就用 continue 跳過列印；到達五時，使用 break 停止。

cues.en: Study the output of zero, two, three, four, five, and you'll see that's exactly what it did.
cues.zh: 查看輸出的零、二、三、四、五，就會發現它確實這樣運作。

cues.en: An alternative syntax is the wild loop which iterates until some Boolean expression is false.
cues.zh: 另一種語法是 while 迴圈，會一直迭代，直到某個布林運算式為假。

cues.en: Here we set up a counter variable called X and loop through printing X only while X is less than 10.
cues.zh: 這裡設定一個名為 x 的計數變數，只要 x 小於 10，就持續迴圈並印出 x。

cues.en: Once it hits 10 the loop ends as you can see in it's output.
cues.zh: 到達 10 時，迴圈結束，輸出結果可以看出來。

cues.en: So, try out a really simple activity that pieces together some of the stuff we've just talked about.
cues.zh: 接著做一個非常簡單的小活動，把剛才介紹的內容組合起來。

cues.en: Your challenge is to write a block of code here that creates a list of integers, loops through each element of the list, and only prints out even numbers in the list.
cues.zh: 挑戰是在這裡寫一段程式碼，建立整數串列，逐一走訪每個元素，並且只印出串列中的偶數。

cues.en: This should just be a matter of rearranging some of the other code in this notebook, so even if you're not comfortable with Python, I encourage you to give it a try.
cues.zh: 應該只需要重新排列 Notebook 裡的其他程式碼，即使不熟悉 Python，也鼓勵你試試看。

cues.en: You'll feel a lot better with Python if you've written something yourself with it, no matter how small.
cues.zh: 只要自己用 Python 寫過東西，不管多小，都會更有信心。

cues.en: Okay, so hopefully you didn't have much trouble with that.
cues.zh: 好，希望這沒有讓你太困擾。

cues.en: Here's my solution.
cues.zh: 這是我的解法。

cues.en: Keep in mind, there's more than one way to do it.
cues.zh: 記得，解法不只一種。

cues.en: Lets type in, my list equals, then square brackets, zero, one, two, five, eight, three.
cues.zh: 輸入 myList =，再加方括號，放入零、一、二、五、八、三。

cues.en: And you can use any numbers that you want.
cues.zh: 你也可以使用任何想用的數字。

cues.en: Then we can save for number in my list, colon, of course you might choose different variable names.
cues.zh: 接著寫 for number in myList:，當然，你可以選擇不同的變數名稱。

cues.en: If number mod two is zero, colon, print number.
cues.zh: 再寫 if number % 2 == 0:，然後 print(number)。

cues.en: And as you can see, we do get the expected output of just the even numbers here.
cues.zh: 你可以看到，這裡確實只輸出偶數，符合預期。

cues.en: Okay so that's everything that's peculiar about Python, for the most part.
cues.zh: 好，Python 比較特別的地方，大致就介紹完了。

cues.en: If you're coming from some other language, that should give you enough knowledge to understand the Python code I'll be showing you in this course, and to work with that code yourself.
cues.zh: 如果你原本使用其他語言，這應該能讓你理解我在課程中展示的 Python 程式碼，也能自己操作。

cues.en: But if you're really befuddled at this point, I do encourage you to grab a larger introductory Python course before moving forward in this one.
cues.zh: 但如果此時還非常困惑，我確實鼓勵你先上一門更完整的 Python 入門課程，再繼續這門課。

cues.en: An ability to read Python code is going to help this course make a lot more sense to you.
cues.zh: 能讀懂 Python 程式碼，會讓這門課更容易理解。

cues.en: But if you think you've got the basics here, lets move forward.
cues.zh: 如果你覺得已經掌握基礎，那就繼續吧。
